commits.message:
refactor: clarify variable names in diagnostic processing loop

Rename ambiguous single-letter and overloaded names in main's
compiler-message loop to reflect their domain meaning:
- msg -> cargo_record (the whole cargo JSON record)
- message -> diagnostic (the inner rustc diagnostic)
- msg_text -> diagnostic_message
- s / span_obj -> span / primary_span
- line_str -> line

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

docs: document core lint module traits and public API

Add module-level documentation to the soroban_cost_lints crate and
docstrings to every public item and trait implementation:

- Crate-level overview covering what each lint detects, the shared
  declare_lint!/marker-struct/LateLintPass shape, and how to add a lint.
- Docs for LintCategory (and its variants), LintMetadata, LINT_METADATA,
  and the register_lints entry point.
- Docs for each lint-pass marker struct and its LateLintPass::check_expr
  method describing the pattern matched and the guards applied.
- Docs for the Visitor trait impls (BindingCollector, LocalReadCollector).

Examples are omitted from doc comments so no doctests are introduced;
intra-doc links reference only in-crate items.

Closes #213

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>
